title: AppcaskConfig
description: Configuration for an appcask app. One file describes the whole shell.

appName.description: Human-readable name shown under the launcher icon.

packageName.description: Reverse-DNS application id, e.g. com.acme.app. Also used as the iOS bundle id.

version.description: Marketing version (x.y.z). The build number is derived unless overridden by the CLI.

startUrl.description: The first URL the WebView loads. Must be https.

internalHosts.description: Hosts that stay inside the WebView. Anything else opens in an external browser tab. Defaults to the host of startUrl.

logo.description: Path (relative to the config file) to a centred splash logo, PNG with transparency.

safeArea.description: How the shell handles notches / status bar / home indicator. 'inset' (default): the WebView is padded to the safe area, filled with statusBar.color — any site looks right with no changes. 'css-vars': the WebView goes edge-to-edge and --appcask-{top,right,bottom,left}-inset are injected for the site to use. 'none': edge-to-edge, no help.

insetSelectors.description: Only with safeArea 'css-vars'. For an edge-to-edge look without editing the site: each entry offsets a fixed/sticky element by the safe-area inset. 'header' -> `header { top: var(--appcask-top-inset) }`; suffix '@bottom' pins to the bottom inset ('.fab@bottom').

mode.description: single = one WebView. tabs / drawer add native chrome (roadmap).

icon.description: Named icon or path to a 24dp glyph.

offlinePage.description: Show a built-in offline screen when a load fails with no connection.

fileAccess.description: Wire up <input type=file>, camera capture, and the native file picker.

downloads.description: Route download responses through the OS download manager.

shareTarget.description: Register the app as an Android share target that forwards to a URL (roadmap).

externalBrowserAuth.description: Domains whose pages must open in Custom Tabs / ASWebAuthenticationSession instead of the WebView (Google, Apple, Microsoft, ...). The redirect back to an internalHost is intercepted and the session handed to the WebView.

separateDocumentPatterns.description: Path globs that are their own document, not a route inside your SPA. These load via native loadUrl to avoid the location.* navigation bounce. Example: /admin/*, /checkout

pathPatterns.description: Verified App Link / Universal Link paths that open the app.

provider.description: fcm covers Android now; APNs is added with the iOS shell.

onTapUrlParam.description: Data key on the push payload holding the URL to open on tap.

updates.description: Safe handling of the live site: a health check after each load, a remote kill-switch, and fall-back to the last version that worked.

manifestUrl.description: A JSON file you host (e.g. https://site.com/.well-known/appcask.json). Fetched on launch; can override startUrl, force a maintenance screen ("blocked": true), require a minimum shell version, or show a banner.

selector.description: A CSS selector that must appear for the page to count as healthy. Default: the page just has to finish loading without an HTTP error.

maxFailures.description: Consecutive failed loads before onUnhealthy fires.

onUnhealthy.description: 'previous': reload the last URL that passed the health check. 'offline-screen': show the built-in screen. 'retry': just reload.

allowedOrigins.description: Origins allowed to call window.appcask at all. Defaults to https://<each internalHost>.

grants.description: Per-scope capability grants. OMIT this and every window.appcask method is allowed on every allowed origin. ADD it and the bridge is default-deny: a method call is refused unless a matching grant lists that capability (PERMISSION_DENIED).

match.description: Which pages this grant applies to. Omit to apply to every allowed origin.

host.description: Exact host, or a leading-dot host (.acme.com) to also match sub-domains.

pathPrefix.description: URL path must start with this.

pathGlob.description: URL path must match this glob (* = one segment, ** = any).

capabilities.description: Method names, a namespace wildcard (secureStore.*, clipboard.*), or * for all.
